title: Pocahontas
author: James Baldwin
summary: 印第安女孩波卡洪塔斯挺身而出，救下被俘的约翰·史密斯。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: There was once a very brave man whose name was John Smith. He came to this country many years ago, when there were great woods everywhere, and many wild beasts and Indians. Many tales are told of his adventures, some of them true and some of them untrue. The most famous of all these is the following:
paragraphs.zh: 从前有一个非常勇敢的人，名叫约翰·史密斯。许多年前，他来到这片土地，那时到处是茂密的森林，还有许多野兽和印第安人。关于他的冒险，流传着许多故事，有些是真的，有些不是。其中最著名的是下面这一个：

paragraphs.en: One day when Smith was in the woods, some Indians came upon him, and made him their prisoner. They led him to their king, and in a short time they made ready to put him to death.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，史密斯在森林里，一些印第安人发现了他，把他俘虏了。他们把他带到国王面前，不久就准备处死他。

paragraphs.en: A large stone was brought in, and Smith was made to lie down with his head on it. Then two tall Indians with big clubs in their hands came forward. The king and all his great men stood around to see. The Indians raised their clubs. In another moment they would fall on Smith's head.
paragraphs.zh: 他们搬来一块大石头，让史密斯躺下，把头枕在石头上。接着，两个高大的印第安人手持大棒走上前来。国王和所有显要人物围在一旁观看。印第安人举起了大棒，再过片刻，大棒就要落在史密斯头上。

paragraphs.en: But just then a little Indian girl rushed in. She was the daughter of the king, and her name was Pocahontastas. She ran and threw herself between Smith and the uplifted clubs. She clasped Smith's head with her arms. She laid her own head upon his.
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，一个印第安小女孩冲了进来。她是国王的女儿，名叫波卡洪塔斯。她跑过去，扑到史密斯和举起的大棒之间，用双臂抱住史密斯的头，把自己的头伏在他头上。

paragraphs.en: "O father!" she cried, "spare this man's life. I am sure he has done you no harm, and we ought to be his friends."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，父亲！”她喊道，“饶了这个人吧。我敢肯定他没有伤害过您，我们应该做他的朋友。”

paragraphs.en: The men with the clubs could not strike, for they did not want to hurt the child. The king at first did not know what to do. Then he spoke to some of his warriors, and they lifted Smith from the ground. They untied the cords from his wrists and feet, and set him free.
paragraphs.zh: 拿大棒的人没法下手，因为他们不想伤到孩子。国王起初不知所措，随后对几个武士说了些什么，他们便把史密斯从地上扶起来，解开他手腕和脚上的绳子，放了他。

paragraphs.en: The next day the king sent Smith home; and several Indians went with him to protect him from harm.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天，国王派人送史密斯回家，还有几个印第安人随行保护他。

paragraphs.en: After that, as long as she lived, Pocahontas was the friend of the white men, and she did a great many things to help them.
paragraphs.zh: 从那以后，波卡洪塔斯一生都是白人的朋友，做了许多帮助他们的事。
